t: The Tritium Breeding Ratio Open Question

t: Tritium Inventory as a Materials Problem
d: Tritium permeates hot metals and is held up in materials; managing where it goes is a materials-and-chemistry safety problem, not just plumbing.
Bred tritium is not all recoverable: decay, permeation, and holdup in walls and processing lines subtract from the surplus available as product.
Surplus tritium above self-sufficiency can be supplied to fusion programs and neutron-target users — the offtake that also seeds new units.
The tritium plant recovers, purifies, stores, and accounts for bred tritium and its helium-3 coproduct, closing the fuel loop.

t: What Is Simulated vs What Is Demonstrated

t: Why We Build the Breeder First
